definition.description: REV | Narrative | Scrub Free-Text (Automation #5, wbs:5.3/5.4; TAD rev 20, ADR-071 to ADR-074). Redacts the 12 free-text columns into their counterparts; nothing reaches a trustee until released. See notes.md.

metadata.description: Environment variable. Recipient of the redaction review message (FR-030, C-TECH-047).
Environment variable. Base URL of the REV Grant Administration app; the card buttons append pagetype, etn and id (C-TECH-047).

When_an_application_status_changes.description: Row MODIFIED on rev_application, filtered to rev_status (message 3, scope 4, runas 3 as REVSafeguardingActionCompletion). Secured outputs: the row carries Tier 4 text.

Stop_unless_eligible_for_panel.description: TAD 5.5: runs when the status becomes Eligible for Panel (6). Every other status change exits here, before anything is read.

Initialise_reasons.description: Fixed reason codes only (rules 7): never text. Safe to log and notify.

Initialise_spans.description: Offsets, a one-character code and a score per span - never text (ADR-071 item 5).

Initialise_prompt_state.description: Rev 20: the column's prompt result, '' (usable), 'error' or 'invalid'. A fixed code, never text.

Initialise_prompt_spans.description: Rev 20: the column's prompt spans - offsets, a code and a score, never text (ADR-072 item 7).

Scrub_free_text.description: One scope so one failure branch catches everything below it.

Get_the_application.description: Re-reads the row: the 12 raw/redacted pairs and the release flag. Secured outputs: Tier 4 narrative text (C-DOM-004, check 11).

Stop_run_already_released.description: Rules 7a rule 1: a released record is never touched - no counterpart, flag or score changes.

Read_redaction_settings.description: TAD 5.5.1, ADR-074: every rev_setting row with its modifiedon, kept to Redaction* in the flow, so a new Redaction* row joins the guard rails with no flow change. Absent is safe.

Filter_redaction_settings.description: ADR-074: only Redaction* rows take part in the guard rails, matched without regard to case.

Select_redaction_setting_times.description: ADR-074 item 5. A-NS-22: modifiedon is ISO 8601 and ticks() reads it. A row without one fails the run, which holds the record.

Compose_threshold_is_number.description: Digits and at most one point, so float() below cannot throw.

Compose_threshold.description: '0.85', '85' and '85%' all give 0.85. -1 means missing or invalid: threshold-missing-or-invalid.
Compose_threshold.inputs: @if(and(outputs('Compose_threshold_is_number'), greater(if(and(greater(outputs('Compose_threshold_number'), 1), lessOrEquals(outputs('Compose_threshold_number'), 100)), div(outputs('Compose_threshold_number'), 100), outputs('Compose_threshold_number')), 0), lessOrEquals(if(and(greater(outputs('Compose_threshold_number'), 1), lessOrEquals(outputs('Compose_threshold_number'), 100)), div(outputs('Compose_threshold_number'), 100), outputs('Compose_threshold_number')), 1)), if(and(greater(outputs('Compose_threshold_number'), 1), lessOrEquals(outputs('Compose_threshold_number'), 100)), div(outputs('Compose_threshold_number'), 100), outputs('Compose_threshold_number')), -1)

Filter_settings_saved_after_auto_release.description: ADR-074 item 5: any other Redaction* row saved after RedactionAutoRelease makes auto-release stale.

Compose_auto_release.description: ADR-071 item 8, ADR-074 item 5: 'on' only for 'true' saved after every other Redaction* row; 'stale' if an edit came later; 'off' otherwise.

Compose_prompt_category_labels.description: ADR-074 item 2: each category row's key to its label. A key not listed here is invalid: a new label still needs the flow.

Select_prompt_categories.description: ADR-074 item 2: one line of plain text per category row.

Filter_invalid_prompt_categories.description: ADR-074 item 4: an empty row or an unknown key makes the whole stage invalid. A partly wrong row is not partly trusted.

Select_prompt_category_lines.description: A-NS-15: sorted by label, so the prompt input does not depend on row order.

Compose_prompt_config.description: ADR-074 items 1-2, ADR-072 item 6: the Categories and AllowedLabels inputs, and the validation allow-list, from the same rows in the same run.

Compose_prompt_calibrated.description: ADR-074 item 5: exactly the valid category labels, saved after every other RedactionPrompt* row. Rev 19's 'true' is not calibrated.

Compose_prompt_runs.description: ADR-072 item 3, ADR-074 item 4: the stage runs only when switched on AND its categories are valid.

Compose_prompt_label_codes.description: ADR-072 item 7: the label of a prompt span comes from this map, never from the prompt.

Compose_scrub_columns.description: The twelve raw/redacted pairs on rev_application, derived from Entity.xml (IMP-1066). A test compares this list with the entity.

Compose_label_text.description: Label per code. Age codes are the rev_agerange bands (FR-027).

Compose_extractor_type_codes.description: Rules 4.2: extractor type to code. '' is kept, O and Y are refined, a type not listed is U and sends the record to review. A-NS-1: the type strings are not yet seen from a live run.

Compose_number_words.description: Numbers 0 to 120 and number words, for an Age value's band.

Compose_kin_tails.description: Each kinship word alone and with ' called', ' named', ' is'. The tested floor (ADR-074 item 3).

Compose_kin_words.description: Rules 5.1 kinship words, normalised ('mother in law'). ADR-074 item 3: the tested floor; RedactionKinshipWordsExtra only adds to it.

Compose_shape_table.description: ADR-071 item 3: UK phone (P) and postcode (S) shapes, 9 a digit and A a letter. ADR-074 item 3: constants, never settings - they are the specification.

Compose_practice_suffixes.description: Rules 6c: an Organization ending in one of these is a GP practice. The tested floor; RedactionPracticeSuffixesExtra only adds (ADR-074 item 3).

Compose_street_words.description: Rules 6b residue: street words. The tested floor; RedactionStreetWordsExtra only adds (ADR-074 item 3).

Compose_practice_words.description: Rules 6b residue: practice words. The tested floor; RedactionPracticeWordsExtra only adds (ADR-074 item 3).

Select_lines_RedactionKinshipWordsExtra.description: ADR-074 item 3: one entry per line, trimmed and lower-cased.

Filter_bad_entries_RedactionKinshipWords.description: ADR-074 item 4: 2 to 40 characters of a-z, space, hyphen and apostrophe, with at least one letter. One bad line makes the row invalid.

Select_forms_RedactionKinshipWordsExtra.description: Each entry in the form the text it is compared with is in, so the floor and an addition match alike.

Select_lines_RedactionPracticeSuffixesEx.description: ADR-074 item 3: one entry per line, trimmed and lower-cased.

Filter_bad_entries_RedactionPracticeSuff.description: ADR-074 item 4: 2 to 40 characters of a-z, space, hyphen and apostrophe, with at least one letter. One bad line makes the row invalid.

Select_forms_RedactionPracticeSuffixesEx.description: Each entry in the form the text it is compared with is in, so the floor and an addition match alike.

Select_lines_RedactionStreetWordsExtra.description: ADR-074 item 3: one entry per line, trimmed and lower-cased.

Filter_bad_entries_RedactionStreetWordsE.description: ADR-074 item 4: 2 to 40 characters of a-z, space, hyphen and apostrophe, with at least one letter. One bad line makes the row invalid.

Select_forms_RedactionStreetWordsExtra.description: Each entry in the form the text it is compared with is in, so the floor and an addition match alike.

Select_lines_RedactionPracticeWordsExtra.description: ADR-074 item 3: one entry per line, trimmed and lower-cased.

Filter_bad_entries_RedactionPracticeWord.description: ADR-074 item 4: 2 to 40 characters of a-z, space, hyphen and apostrophe, with at least one letter. One bad line makes the row invalid.

Select_forms_RedactionPracticeWordsExtra.description: Each entry in the form the text it is compared with is in, so the floor and an addition match alike.

Compose_word_list_checks.description: ADR-074 item 4: a present row is valid only as a whole. An invalid row is ignored, the floor applies and the record gets redaction-setting-invalid.

Select_extra_kin_tails.description: ADR-074 item 3: the tails are generated for each added kinship word, as for the floor.

Compose_word_lists.description: ADR-074 item 3: each list is the tested floor plus the valid additions. A setting can add, never remove.

List_postcode_districts.description: ADR-073 item 1: the postcode register, once per run, outward codes only. A-NS-21: one response holds all rows. A failed read is postcode-register-unavailable.

Compose_register_rows.description: ADR-073 item 2: a failed read gives no rows, which fails closed below.

Compose_postcode_register.description: ADR-073 items 1-2: '|AB1|AB10|...|', tested with contains(). Fewer than 3,000 rows means the seed did not run: postcode-register-unavailable.

Compose_register_shape_table.description: ADR-073 items 4-5: F a postcode without its space, D a district on its own. Constants: they are the specification.

For_each_column.description: One pass per raw/redacted pair. Sequential: the stages share offset-only variables.

Compose_raw_text.description: The raw (secured, Tier 4) column for this pass. Secured: narrative text.

Scrub_the_column_if_it_has_text.description: An empty raw column is out of scope (rules 7).

Keep_or_scrub_the_column.description: Rules 7a rule 2: only an EMPTY counterpart is written. To have a column scrubbed again, the grant admin clears it.

Append_reason_kept_counterpart.description: Rules 7a rule 3: a counterpart already holds text, treated as the grant admin's. It is not rewritten, and the flow cannot release the record.

Scan_the_column_in_windows.description: Rules 5.4: windows of at most 5,000 characters with a 200-character overlap. 250 windows cover the 1,048,576-character column.

Compose_window_end.description: Rules 5.4: at most 5,000 characters (A-NS-3), cut at the last space after the 200-character overlap. A-NS-18: take() on a string, lastIndexOf() -1 when absent. Secured: reads the text.

Extract_entities_from_the_window.description: A-NS-13: AI Builder prebuilt entity extraction via the Dataverse connector (operation and parameter names guessed). A-NS-5: language en. A-NS-12: secured both ways - text in, entity values out.

Record_an_extractor_failure.description: Any failure of the call (no credits, throttled, refused): ai-error for this column. Degrade, never disclose (TAD 5.5).

Compose_window_entities.description: A-NS-16: the entity array, at either documented-looking path. Null means the answer could not be read, which is ai-error, never 'no entities'.

Select_extractor_entities.description: Keeps type, offsets and score, and replaces the value by its normalised form for the GP and age checks. Secured: it holds narrative text.

Select_extractor_ages.description: The age an Age value states: its first number, or a tens word plus a unit ('ninety-one'), within the first three words. -1 when none.

Select_practice_suffix_trials.description: Rules 6c, ADR-074 item 3: each entity against each practice suffix. A hit gives 'startIndex:length'; nothing else leaves this action.

inputs.select: @if(and(less(item(), mul(length(body('Select_extractor_entities')), length(outputs('Compose_word_lists')?['practiceSuffixes']))), endsWith(concat(' ', coalesce(first(skip(body('Select_extractor_entities'), div(item(), length(outputs('Compose_word_lists')?['practiceSuffixes']))))?['norm'], '')), concat(' ', first(skip(outputs('Compose_word_lists')?['practiceSuffixes'], mod(item(), length(outputs('Compose_word_lists')?['practiceSuffixes']))))))), concat(string(first(skip(body('Select_extractor_entities'), div(item(), length(outputs('Compose_word_lists')?['practiceSuffixes']))))?['startIndex']), ':', string(first(skip(body('Select_extractor_entities'), div(item(), length(outputs('Compose_word_lists')?['practiceSuffixes']))))?['length'])), '')

Select_extractor_spans.description: ADR-071 items 1, 4: type to code (rules 4.2), Organization only as a GP practice, Age as its band. A-NS-2: startIndex counted in the units substring() uses. No text leaves this action.

Filter_unmapped_entities.description: A type the rules do not know (A-NS-1). Never kept silently: the record goes to review.

Filter_person_spans.description: Names, refined one by one below (kinship, rules 5.1).

Filter_other_spans.description: Every other redacted span. Code '' is a retained type (rules 4.2) and is dropped here.

Refine_each_name.description: ADR-071 item 4: a name next to a kinship word becomes [FAMILY MEMBER]. Sequential, because it appends to a variable.

Compose_name_before.description: Up to 60 characters before the name, normalised (lower case, punctuation as spaces). Secured: narrative text.

Compose_name_after.description: Up to 40 characters after the name, lower case, a possessive 's removed. Secured: narrative text.

Compose_name_after_words.description: The words after the first character of the text after the name. Secured.

Filter_kinship_before.description: 'my husband Derek', 'our son is Liam': the text before ends with a kinship word, with my/our/his/her/their in the 3 words before it.

Filter_kinship_after.description: 'Will, my grandson,': a comma, bracket or dash, a possessive, at most one word, then a kinship word.

Detect_shapes_in_the_window.description: Stage 2 (ADR-071 item 3, ADR-073): UK phone and postcode shapes, and register-confirmed postcodes, found without regular expressions.

Select_window_classes.description: ADR-071 item 3, the Select_referee_phone_digits pattern: each character of the window as 9 (digit), A (letter) or itself.

Compose_window_class_string.description: The class string, padded: one space before (the boundary at position 0) and 24 after (every slice is total).

Select_shape_slices.description: For each position: the class character before it and the 24 from it.

Filter_shape_candidates.description: Positions not preceded by a digit or letter whose slice starts like a phone or postcode shape.

Select_shape_spans.description: A shape span carries no score: 2 sits above every real score, so it neither raises nor lowers the record confidence.

Select_register_trials.description: ADR-073 items 4-5: each candidate against each register shape, only when the register is available. A district followed by an inward code is not one.

Select_register_spans.description: A register span carries no score, like a shape span.

Use_the_prompt_on_the_window.description: Stage 3 (ADR-072, ADR-074): only when RedactionPromptStage is on and the category rows are valid. Every answer is validated before use.

Compose_prompt_request.description: ADR-074 item 1, A-NS-20: the three inputs of the prompt's fixed template. Secured: the window.

Run_the_redaction_prompt.description: ADR-072: runs the exported prompt by its id (A-NS-9; A-NS-23 outside DEV). Operation, id and input names match the DEV designer's saved action (E1, 2026-10-07). A-NS-20: input length. Secured both ways.

Record_a_prompt_call_failure.description: Any failure of the call (no credits, throttled, refused, wrong shape): prompt-error for this column (ADR-072 item 8). Degrade, never disclose.

Compose_prompt_answer.description: The answer's text and finishReason, at the path the DEV designer writes for this action's outputs (E1, 2026-10-07). Null is not usable: prompt-error.

Compose_prompt_answer_usable.description: A-NS-8: only a normal stop with text is usable. Anything else is prompt-error (ADR-072 item 8).

Parse_the_prompt_answer.description: A-NS-10: the answer's text is JSON. Unparseable text fails this action: prompt-error (ADR-072 item 8). Secured.

Validate_the_prompt_answer.description: ADR-072 item 6: every item is checked before any span is used. A failure in here means the answer is malformed: prompt-output-invalid.

Select_prompt_items.description: ADR-072 items 5-6: the answer must be an array of {label, quote}. Anything else fails this action, and the answer is invalid. Secured: quotes.

Select_prompt_item_checks.description: ADR-072 item 6, ADR-074 item 2: the label is one of this run's category labels; the quote is 2 to 200 characters.

Select_prompt_item_counts.description: A-NS-24: split() finds the quote verbatim, left to right, without overlap. n is how often it occurs in the window.

Select_prompt_occurrence_counts.description: Its input rows carry the quotes: secured.

Select_prompt_trials.description: ADR-072 item 6: each occurrence of each quote, kept only at word boundaries ('Ann' in 'annual' is skipped). Offsets only.
